item_addons.name: Broken Bulb
item_addons.description:
!! THIS ADD-ON IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE
(
This
Unlockable
can no longer be obtained and stockpiles can no longer be used.
If it is an
Event Unlockable, it may return with its associated Event.
)
A damaged bulb that **causes** a spooky flickering effect.
**Causes** the
**Flashlight**
to flicker.
**Increases**
the brightness of the Beam by
**+15%**.
**Increases**
the duration of a successful Blind by
**+30%**.
**Increases**
the spookiness.
The
*Broken Bulb*
is only available during
Halloween Events.

item_addons.name: Refined Serum
item_addons.description:
!! THIS ADD-ON IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE
(
This
Unlockable
can no longer be obtained and stockpiles can no longer be used.
If it is an
Event Unlockable, it may return with its associated Event.
)
STOCKPILES MAY STILL BE USED IN **TRIALS**
"A refined version of the
Putrid **Serum**
that is mostly safe for human consumption.
Mostly."
While healing yourself or another Survivor with the
**Med-Kit**, press the
`Secondary Action button`
to trigger the following effect for
**16 seconds**:
**Increases**
all Movement speeds by
**+5%**.
Creates a Blight trail behind the **affected** Survivor.
*Refined Serum*
consumes the
**Med-Kit**
after trigger its effect.
The
*Refined Serum*
is only available during
Halloween Events.
